title: An kai iyakar mahalli
description: Wannan hira tana kaiwa iyakar ƙwaƙwalwar AI, kamar allo da yake cikewa. Za mu iya ƙara sararin ƙwaƙwalwar (wanda ake kira girman mahalli) don ya tuna ƙarin bayani, amma hakan na iya amfani da ƙarin ƙwaƙwalwar kwamfutarku. Haka kuma za mu iya rage abin da ake shigarwa, wato cire wani ɓangare na tarihin hirar don samar da wuri ga sabbin saƙonni.
lastRequestOverflowed: Buƙatar ƙarshe ta wuce sararin mahalli.
contextOverflowDetail: Wannan buƙatar tana buƙatar token {{request}}, amma sararin mahallin samfurin yana iya ɗaukar {{context}} kawai.
contextOverflowGeneric: Buƙatar ta wuce girman mahallin da ake da shi.
emptyReply: Samfurin ya gama ba tare da mayar da amsa ba. Gwada sake samar da amsa, ko duba saitunan mai ba da sabis.

engine.unknown: Injin samfurin ya ba da rahoton kuskuren da ba a zata ba.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_FAILED: Ba a iya loda samfurin ba.
engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Injin yanzu ba ya goyon bayan tsarin wannan samfurin. Sabunta injin daga Saituna na iya ƙara goyon baya.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Samfurin ya ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo wajen lodawa kuma an tsayar da shi. Ƙaramin samfuri ko ƙaramin girman mahalli yawanci yana taimakawa.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Wani ɗakin karatu da injin yake buƙata ba ya nan, don haka ba zai iya farawa ba.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Direban GPU ɗinku ya tsufa sosai ga wannan injin. Sabunta direban, ko sauya zuwa injin CPU a Saituna, zai gyara wannan.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Babu isasshiyar ƙwaƙwalwa don gudanar da wannan samfurin. Ƙaramin samfuri ko ƙaramin girman mahalli yawanci yana taimakawa.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Injin llama.cpp ya tsaya ba zato ba tsammani. Sake aika saƙon zai sake kunna shi; idan yana ci gaba da tsayawa, manhajar tsaro ko direban GPU na iya zama dalili.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Injin llama.cpp yana aiki, amma Jan ba zai iya haɗawa da shi a wannan kwamfutar ba (127.0.0.1). VPN, wakili ko manhajar tsaro na iya toshe haɗin cikin kwamfuta.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Ba a goyon bayan samfuran cikin kwamfuta a na’urar sarrafa wannan kwamfutar. An gina injin Jan na cikin kwamfuta don kwamfutocin Mac masu Apple Silicon (M1 ko sabo), don haka ba zai iya farawa a Intel Mac ba. Masu ba da sabis na gajimare da na musamman suna aiki har yanzu.
engine.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Ɗaya daga cikin saitunan samfurin ba shi da inganci.
engine.IO_ERROR: Ba a iya karanta ko rubuta wani fayil yayin fara samfurin ba.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: An sami kuskure a cikin Jan yayin fara samfurin.
